correction.previous_assertion: The parent C06 source_grounding.S08 and prior adapter discovery treated the source content hash as if the authored operation supplied a checksum.
correction.verified_fact: The admitted strict operation contains a literal implementation.use_cases source path and symbol CreateV2, but zero checksum fields anywhere in the operation. Its metadata file hash and the current source file hash are observed snapshot commitments, not historical checksums declared by the author.
correction.preserve_history: Do not overwrite the frozen parent contract or pretend it previously allowed this. This supplement is a newly reviewed additive current-reference capability after actual RED.
correction.schema_fact: ArchitectureEvidence.Checksum is optional; validateEvidence checks syntax only when nonempty. A checksum-absent strict operation is schema-valid. A present nonmatching checksum remains a failed source citation.
correction.rationale: Existing literal authored area paths already bind current admitted filesystem metadata and current anchored source hashes without requiring a checksum authored in the layer declaration. A strict literal UseCases path+unique symbol can similarly prove the current authored read-role relation if the caller independently binds the same current source file. This establishes current snapshot evidence only and never invents an earlier authored pin or Git certification.

allowed_delta.capability: Current literal strict operation read-area attribution with a diagnosed absent authored source checksum

current_reference_proof.metadata_admission: The complete strict operation metadata document is admitted through the production descriptor loader under the same source identity and current source snapshot/admission as the referenced source file. Keep its exact current full-file hash in the existing metadata->source chain. Metadata content stays data.
current_reference_proof.path: UseCases.SourcePath is one literal safe relative Go file path; not a test file, excluded secret, glob, traversal or symlink target. No source admission expansion or neighboring source inheritance.
current_reference_proof.caller: At least one explicit retained caller Go selector must bind that same SourceIdentity+SourcePath to an ExpectedHash equal to the current admitted source file hash and uniquely resolved non-test declaration. Its original selector ID/path/hash is preserved. It may be a requested same-file helper; do not require guessing a source hash from metadata.
current_reference_proof.caller_origin: Prepare uses validated caller selectors. Expand first performs trusted base/history replay and uses only exact selectors retained in the returned immutable cumulative RetrievalPlan. Incidental AST hops, same-file context, arbitrary snapshot declarations, metadata-generated seeds without caller provenance or rejected Expand attempts cannot establish the required current caller pin.
current_reference_proof.declared_symbol: UseCases.Symbol must be nonempty and resolve uniquely in the exact referenced file using supported qualified/unqualified declaration matching. Independently verify full admitted same-source/package parse and uniqueness; duplicate methods/types, alias ambiguity, homonyms or parse failures fail closed. The source hash alone cannot compensate for a missing/ambiguous symbol.
current_reference_proof.package_search_scope: Full admitted package parsing is required for uniqueness. Unreadable, skipped, limit-terminated or unparsable relevant package source cannot silently be omitted. This certifies uniqueness within the actual complete admitted search scope, not excluded or unknown repository source.

checksum_branch.nonempty_matching: Keep the existing strict checksum path. The authored checksum must equal the actual current content hash; caller binding and all existing freshness/uniqueness checks still apply.
checksum_branch.nonempty_mismatching: Reject positive area/alias proof and emit existing stale/not-verified diagnostics. Never reinterpret a mismatch as optional/unpinned.
checksum_branch.empty: Only the new v1.2 current-reference path may supply current authored attribution, after the independent caller/source/hash/snapshot/unique-symbol checks above. Emit explicit unpinned diagnostic and current-only evidence limitations.

current_reference_proof.current_file_membership: A proven reference attributes the exact current source file; other explicit same-file helpers at the same current full-file hash can belong to that authored read area. Use the declared unique use-case as the layer witness. The sourceDir label is provenance only, and neither sibling files nor a parent/neighbor directory become attributed.
current_reference_proof.aliases: Retain backend.usecase and implementation.use_cases:<sourceDir>; emit additive use_cases:<sourceDir> from the exact declared use-case witness with current metadata/source chain. No role label from a case expectation or operation prose.
current_reference_proof.freshness: Metadata and source hashes/snapshot/admission are independently revalidated before final companion. Changed source or changed metadata gives existing stale/scope failure, no surviving positive proof. Forged serialized proof/pack/companion cannot bypass trusted core replay.
current_reference_proof.bounds: Existing strict YAML/parser counts, loaded-source bounds, selector/result limits and joint certificate budgets still apply. New diagnostic/chain bytes enter final binding and full current-bundle accounting.

honest_output.binding: SourceIdentity plus operation RelativePath and stable evidence/diagnostic identity derived from operation hash, current referenced source path/hash and matching retained selector IDs. Message identifies no authored checksum, current snapshot only. Preserve shared core diagnostic ABI.
honest_output.chain: Exact admitted current operation hash -> exact declared source symbol and current file hash/snapshot. Label relation and limitations current literal authored reference with caller pin; authored checksum absent. Do not state checksum verified or historical pin preserved.
honest_output.separate_dimensions: Current authored read-area membership may be proved while absent historical checksum remains diagnosed PARTIAL. A successful current area proof prevents a false missing-area record for that exact file; it does not erase the unpinned diagnostic, raw Git-pin limitation or another mandatory contract failure.
honest_output.not_a_historical_pin: Do not write ExpectedHash/Checksum into target metadata, rewrite a cached reference, synthesize a Git revision, upgrade revision certification, or silently replace a stale authored checksum.

scoped_search_correction.search_claim: No matching supported canonical target/literal authored area/strict UseCases current-reference in the admitted read-area attribution search scope.
scoped_search_correction.area_inventory: The supported authored area roots (.ai/architecture.yaml and .ai/service.yaml layer/composition fields) and strict endpoint Implementation.UseCases references. The latter are relevant to a missing anchor when their SourcePath can target that exact anchor file. Invalid operation syntax with unknowable reference scope must remain explicitly incomplete.
include_completeness_blockers: Unresolved canonical profile or catalog verification
Loader limits, errors or unreadability relevant to supported area metadata or anchor package
Strict UseCases reference targeting the anchor file that cannot be independently resolved/pinned under one of the permitted checksum branches
Strict operation parse failure that prevents determining its target scope
scoped_search_correction.exclude_from_this_completeness_dimension: Unrelated prose/statement citation failures in .ai/architecture/service.yaml are separately reported metadata evidence. They are not consumed as area declarations, so their stale/unpinned/non-admitted citations cannot by themselves negate completeness of this scoped literal-area search. Likewise valid operation references to other files do not negate the anchor-file lookup.
scoped_search_correction.retain_every_diagnostic: Do not delete or downgrade METADATA_CITATION_STALE/UNPINNED/NOT_VERIFIED or any invalid area/operation diagnostic. Keep them in metadata_diagnostics with original source/path/status. If any is independently mandatory for a contract or evidence requirement, that requirement still fails.
scoped_search_correction.implementation_recommendation: Separate literal-area parser diagnostics from supplemental general citation diagnostics at their producer or carry typed private provenance; do not use generic code-string suppression, last-key-wins parsing or blanket status rewriting. Feed only verified area-search blockers into gap.coverage, while exposing the complete metadata diagnostic set.
scoped_search_correction.missing_area_record: S04/S07 can have scoped coverage.Complete true and requirement_state NOT_VERIFIED for missing authored binding after an actual complete area search. This says nothing about unrelated cited documents, repository-wide absence or business role authority.
